title: Dragon Ball Daima Mod
description: A mod based on Dragon Ball Daima series.
body:
![Dragon ball daima mod logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c0a3c4a80dc5e03da087ff92b5031c7c3608799f.png)

### **This mod isn't a official project, is based on the orginal series, _Dragon Ball Daima_.**
**This mod was made with [Mcreator](https://mcreator.net/).**

The mod focuses on the **Third Eye**, that gives an unwordly power to the person who equip in her
forehead, to achieve this artefact you must to travel to the Nether and find a ruin, there a box contains inside it the eye but before you will have to finish off someone...

- When you start a world, you will receive the _Book of Magic Objetcs_ that is the mod guide.
- I recommend you check the **advancements** in the game for complete the adventure.                                         
<details>
<summary>Advancements</summary>

![Progresos](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/eca59743937defe77175c7fd2a9e199e73b7bbf7_0.webp)

</details>

- If you find mistakes, in the controls you can change the key for hide or show the "Third Eye interface/overlay".

If you want to watch the process of making the mod **(coming soon: a video)** go to my YouTube channel [@Adrix1](https://www.youtube.com/@Adrix1YT).
